voxelvelo.hint.trainer_not_connected: Trainer not connected, you can only coast. Press %s for bike settings.
voxelvelo.config.title: VoxelVelo Bike Settings
voxelvelo.config.telemetry: Power %s W    Cadence %s rpm    Heart rate %s bpm
voxelvelo.sources.propulsion.tip: Where your power comes from. A disconnected trainer means coasting, not a silent switch to the keyboard.
voxelvelo.sources.steering.tip: Road follow keeps the bike on the centre of a road of your chosen blocks. Keyboard steering still works when it is idle.
voxelvelo.sources.brake.tip: The keyboard brake always works as well; the stronger brake wins.
voxelvelo.sources.gear.tip: Gear shifts from the keyboard and from this source both count.
voxelvelo.road.title: Road & Terrain
voxelvelo.road.hint: Road follow keeps the bike centred on a road made of these blocks.
voxelvelo.junction.title: Junction ahead
voxelvelo.menu.button.tip: Open the VoxelVelo bike settings. The Open Bike Settings key does the same while you play.
voxelvelo.config.keyboard.tip: How the keyboard stands in for pedalling and steering.
voxelvelo.config.trainer_page.tip: Connect a Bluetooth smart trainer (FTMS) and tune the resistance it gets.
voxelvelo.config.obc.tip: Connect an OpenBikeControl device, such as the BikeControl phone app, for steering, brake and gears.
voxelvelo.config.sources.tip: Choose which device controls pedalling, steering, braking and gears. They can be mixed freely.
voxelvelo.config.road.tip: Hands-free steering: which blocks count as road, how wide a road may be, and the junction question.
voxelvelo.config.stats.tip: The overlay of other riders' watts and heart rate, and what you share with them.
voxelvelo.config.rider.tip: Your weight, your own speed limit and the riding panel.
voxelvelo.config.virtual_power.tip: The watts the pedal key stands for. More watts accelerate faster and climb better.
voxelvelo.config.steering_sensitivity.ti: How far the steering keys turn the handlebar. Lower is gentler, which helps at speed.
voxelvelo.rider.mass.tip: Your weight in kg. Heavier riders accelerate slower and roll downhill faster. The server keeps it in a sane range.
voxelvelo.rider.limit.tip: Your own top speed in km/h, off by default. Handy to keep an even pace with other riders. The server applies it.
voxelvelo.rider.hud.tip: Show the small panel with power, cadence, speed, grade and gear while you ride.
voxelvelo.rider.hud_sources.tip: Show on the riding panel which device drives each control, with a green dot when it is connected and a red one when not.
voxelvelo.rider.stats.tip: Show the list of other riders with their watts, speed, cadence and heart rate. The Toggle Rider Stats key does the same.
voxelvelo.rider.share_watts.tip: Let other riders see your watts.
voxelvelo.rider.share_hr.tip: Let other riders see your heart rate. It is health data, so nothing is sent while this is off.
voxelvelo.trainer.scan.tip: Search for Bluetooth fitness machines nearby. Trainers that speak FTMS are marked with a star.
voxelvelo.trainer.disconnect.tip: Disconnect, and do not reconnect by itself until you pick the device again.
voxelvelo.trainer.forget.tip: Forget the saved device so it is no longer reconnected automatically.
voxelvelo.config.auto_connect.tip: Reconnect to the last trainer when you join a world.
voxelvelo.config.resistance.tip: Let the game set your trainer's resistance from the slope and the ground. Needs a trainer that supports it.
voxelvelo.config.intensity.tip: How strongly slope and ground change the resistance. 100 percent matches the game's physics, 0 keeps the trainer flat.
voxelvelo.config.slope_window.tip: Blocks ahead and behind over which the slope is averaged. A longer window smooths single steps, which suits slow-reacting trainers.
voxelvelo.obc.mode.tip: How to look for devices: over the local network, over Bluetooth, or both. The phone app uses the network.
voxelvelo.obc.connect.tip: Connect to the address you typed.
voxelvelo.obc.manual.tip: The device's address as host:port, as shown in the app. Use it when the device is not found automatically.
voxelvelo.road.add.tip: Add the block id or #tag you typed to the road blocks.
voxelvelo.road.add_under.tip: Add the block you are standing on to the road blocks.
voxelvelo.road.add_looking.tip: Add the block you are looking at to the road blocks.
voxelvelo.road.reset.tip: Back to the default road blocks: stone and gravel.
voxelvelo.road.input.tip: A block id such as minecraft:gravel, or a tag such as #minecraft:sand.
voxelvelo.road.half_width.tip: Roads wider than this on each side count as open ground, and road following lets go of the steering there.
voxelvelo.road.junction.tip: Ask whether to go left or right at junctions while road following. Off: the widest way is taken.
voxelvelo.road.cooldown.tip: The least time between two questions. Junctions inside it are decided automatically.
voxelvelo.config.virtual_shifting.tip: Lets the game's twelve gears change the load on your trainer, so shifting up feels heavier and shifting down lighter, although the trainer has no gears.
voxelvelo.config.physical_ratio.tip: The real gear ratio you ride on the trainer, chainring over cog, for example 50/20 = 2.5. Virtual gear 6 matches it.
voxelvelo.config.wheel_circumference.tip: Circumference of your trainer's wheel in meters. Used to work out speed from cadence when the trainer reports no speed.
voxelvelo.rider.heart_graph.tip: Show the heart rate graph in the top-right corner while you ride.
voxelvelo.rider.junction_hud.tip: Show the left or right question on screen when a junction comes up while road following.
voxelvelo.keyboard.title: Keyboard
voxelvelo.stats.title: HUD & Rider Stats
voxelvelo.rider.title: Rider & HUD
voxelvelo.rider.note: Mass and speed limit are sent to the server, which clamps them.
voxelvelo.obc.title: OpenBikeControl
voxelvelo.obc.hint: Start BikeControl or another OBC device first.
voxelvelo.obc.manual_invalid: Enter a host and port like 127.0.0.1:8080
voxelvelo.sources.title: Input Sources
voxelvelo.sources.note2: Other controls fall back to the keyboard.
voxelvelo.trainer.title: Choose Trainer
voxelvelo.trainer.hint: Devices marked with a star advertise a fitness machine.
tooltip.voxelvelo.bike_helmet: Halves crash damage on a bike. Dyeable.
tooltip.voxelvelo.replace_tire: Keep the wheel! Craft with a Tire to repair.
menu.voxelvelo.slot_order: Slots: Front wheel / Rear wheel / Handlebars / Saddle / Pedals
menu.voxelvelo.repair_hint: Click a wheel with a Tire to replace its tire.
menu.voxelvelo.disassembly_hint: Close, then sneak + wrench to disassemble.
tooltip.voxelvelo.bike_use: Use to place; sneak + empty hand to pick up.
tooltip.voxelvelo.wrench_use: Use on a bike to maintain; sneak + use to disassemble.
message.voxelvelo.missing_parts: Cannot ride: install both wheels, handlebars, and a saddle.
message.voxelvelo.no_pedals: No pedals installed: this bike can only coast.
menu.voxelvelo.burst: Burst tire: riding is slowed. Replace the tire.
menu.voxelvelo.repair_short: Click a wheel with any Tire to refit it.
tooltip.voxelvelo.tire.road: Fast on roads, slips on loose ground
tooltip.voxelvelo.tire.mountain: Grips loose ground, drags on roads
tooltip.voxelvelo.bars_drop: Aero: less drag, less steering lock
tooltip.voxelvelo.bars_flat: Upright: more steering lock, more drag
